candidate_windows.window_text: We used a GPU cluster with 16 NVIDIA A40 GPUs, 1988G memory, and 104 CPU cores for the experiments. Factuality pretraining with the default hyperparameters takes around 1.5 hours, while finetuning language models on the FactCollect dataset takes around 30 minutes.
